3. Material — Suggested material is high density polyethylene for extrusion with following properties: 



a) Density 

b) Viscosity 

c) Melt flow index 

d) Tensile strength 

e) Elongation

h) Colour

4. Workmanship — Plastic tubes shall have smooth surface. They shall have sufficient bursting 
Strength (see 5.2) as it involves safety of the firer. They shall therefore, preferably be extruded and 
bi*axially oriented. 

5. Inspection and Tests —The supplier shall ensure the quality of the product by checking samples 
from the continuous running production from time to time* On submission of the bulk, the consignee 
will do the sampling inspection as prescribed in IS : 2500 ( Part 1 )-1973 'Sampling inspection tables: 
Parti Inspection by attributes and by count of defects {first revision Y for dimensional and visual 
parameters with AQL as Critical — 0. Major « 0'65 and Minor =« 1"5,

5.2 Bursting Strengtti — Five samples will be taken from each consignment and tested for the bursting 
strength in a suitable apparatus and the average value shall not be less than 26'3 kg/cm^ and not a 
single one less than 246 kg/cm^ when tested in accordance with 12.5 of IS ; 1060 ( Part 1 )-1966 
'Methods of sampling and test for paper and allied products; Part 1 (revised)'. 

5.3 Chen)icai Analysis — ShaW be done to ensure that no additive material has been used along with 
basic material which will contain chlorine or chlorine compounds or which will affect the neutral nature 
of the burr material. 

6. General Requirements — Shall conform to IS : 12497 ( Part 1 )-1988 'Specification for plastic 
cartridges for shot guns: Pant 1 General requirements'. 

7. Marking — Each packet of the tubes shall be marked legibly and indelibly with manufacturer's name 
or trade-mark, year of manufacture, from, to, quantity, weight and the number of this standard. 

8. Packing —Packing shall be done with the tubes in vertical position and each layer shall be 
separated with a paper. The total weight of the package shall be as agreed to between the supplier 
and the purchaser. 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

This standard is being issued in the following parts, Part 1 covering general requirements for 
shot gun plastic cartridges and subsequent parts covering the plastic components: 

Part 1 General requirements 

Part 2 Blank cartridges 

Part 3 Plastic body tube 

Part 4 Plastic base wad 

Part 5 Plastic power piston
